about_the_game:
A stunning soundtrack that colors the excitement of Street Fighter 6 Year 1.

An album featuring the themes of the four fighters added in Year 1 of "Street Fighter 6" is set to be released!

Enjoy the HipHop tracks that continue to color the ever-exciting "Street Fighter 6" one year after its release!
